name: Phoenix Islands Protected Area
description: Midway between Australia and Hawaii, this remote reserve in Kiribati covers 408,250 square kilometres of open Pacific, roughly the size of California, yet only about 25 square kilometres of it is land. Its eight low coral islands are surrounded by largely untouched reefs and 14 underwater seamounts. The waters hold around 200 coral species, 500 fish species and 18 marine mammals, and the islands host 44 bird species.
